note: Everything the Live model may do. Enums must match RescueCore. The model has no tools for overlay coordinates, step changes, stopping the metronome, or dialing. report_scene only describes the camera view for the screen; it never reaches the protocol.

function_declarations.name: report_finding
function_declarations.description: Report something you heard or saw about the patient or scene. This is an observation only. The app decides what happens next.

state_version.description: The version from the latest state brief.

function_declarations.name: report_resources
function_declarations.description: Report equipment or people visible or mentioned in the scene.

function_declarations.name: say
function_declarations.description: Play one approved phrase by id. Only phrases listed in the latest state brief are allowed.

function_declarations.name: locate_object
function_declarations.description: Ask the app to find an object in the current camera view and point to it.

function_declarations.name: log_event
function_declarations.description: Add a note to the event log. It is labeled as AI-inferred.

function_declarations.name: report_scene
function_declarations.description: Describe what the camera shows right now, for a short read on the rescuer's screen. Call it whenever the view changes, for example when a person comes into view, and at least every few seconds while one is in view. It never changes the step, plays nothing, and its result is silent.

sees.description: At most 12 words. Only what the camera shows about the person: position, eyes open or closed, movement, visible chest rise, skin color, blood, or an AED. Plain observation, no conclusions. 'No person in view' when there is none.

headline.description: At most 8 words. The single most important thing in the scene.

prediction.description: At most 12 words, starting with 'Possible', or 'Not enough information yet'. Never a condition stated as fact.

note.description: One short sentence: what changed since your last report and why it matters to the rescuer.

emergency.description: At most 6 words, only when the camera shows a possible emergency: a person lying on the floor or ground, slumped, not moving, bleeding, choking, or clearly in distress, such as 'Person down on the floor'. An empty string otherwise.

state_version.description: The version from the latest state brief.
